written.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO
written.summary: Nvidia co‑founder Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO, president and board member after reports of two extramarital affairs. CFO Colette Kress was appointed interim CEO and the board named Harvey C. Jones its first chair, while Nvidia shares fell more than 5% in trading.

written.headline: Firms linked to Alice Huang invest $14 million in DeepSeek and promise Nvidia Blackwell chips
written.summary: Companies tied to Alice Huang invested $14 million in the Chinese AI lab DeepSeek. The investors also pledged to supply Nvidia’s Blackwell chips, which are prohibited for export to China.

written.headline: Nvidia shares fall 14% after CEO Jensen Huang resigns, market cap slips below $4 trillion
written.summary: Nvidia’s stock dropped 14% at the opening bell following the resignation of co‑founder and CEO Jensen Huang. The decline erased more than $600 billion in value, pushing the company’s market capitalization below $4 trillion for the first time since 2025.

written.headline: Norwest closes $4 billion fund to back AI startups in US, India and Israel
written.summary: Norwest has closed a $4 billion, 18th fund – its largest – to invest in AI companies across the United States, India and Israel. The firm will target early‑stage and growth ventures in physical AI, voice AI, agentic cybersecurity, aerospace and healthcare.
